text: University Equities Inc. and Triogreen East GP Inc. the owners of 40 University Avenue, located on the southwest corner of University Avenue and Wellington Street West, are renovating the ground floor to improve the relationship to the street. One of the proposed improvements is the construction of an accessibility ramp between the sidewalk and the building. The proposed ramp will occupy some of the private open space in front of the building. On this section of University Avenue the lane widths for vehicles travelling southbound south of Wellington Avenue are wider than the matching lanes to the north of Wellington Avenue and considerably wider than the City's current lane width guidelines.
